subtitle: How two-factor authentication works, and which kind to use.

subsections.title: Two-Factor Authentication
subsections.summary: What it is and why it matters.

blocks.html: Authentication is how a service checks that you are you. A password alone is the weakest form — it can be guessed, leaked or phished. Adding a second factor, like an authenticator app or a hardware key, stops most account takeovers even when the password is stolen, and passkeys go further by removing the password entirely.
